analysis.material: tin-plate metal with printed paper label
analysis.descriptor: three upright cylindrical tins in graduated sizes, tall, medium and short, each with a thin gold rolled rim at top and bottom, the smallest topped by a clear translucent snap lid. the wrap label is deep maroon at the edges with a large cream and gold arch outlining a bright orange panel. inside the arch sits a round portrait of a blue-skinned deity with a peacock feather crown on a pale yellow disc, flanked by small ribbon banners and a registered mark at upper right. a red rectangular plate with bold white lettering lies below, then yellow and white script lines, and a tiny green dot symbol sits at the side.
